laser_cannon.name: Laser Cannon
laser_cannon.description: Standard-issue forward-mounted laser weapon - balanced range, rate, and punch

pulse_blaster.name: Pulse Blaster
pulse_blaster.description: Light rapid-fire emitter - weak per hit and none too precise, but the fastest trigger and muzzle velocity on the market

heavy_cannon.name: Heavy Cannon
heavy_cannon.description: Slow-cycling mass-driver - a single lumbering slug that hits far harder than anything else in its slot

scatter_gun.name: Scatter Gun
scatter_gun.description: Fires a wide fan of pellets - devastating up close, unreliable at range

afterburner.name: Afterburner
afterburner.description: Overdriven thruster for short bursts of extra speed

ion_thruster.name: Ion Thruster
ion_thruster.description: Efficient low-thrust engine favored by haulers

cargo_expansion.name: Cargo Expansion Module
cargo_expansion.description: Extra pressurized hold space, at the cost of maneuverability

reinforced_hull.name: Reinforced Hull Plating
reinforced_hull.description: Extra armour plating - soaks more damage before the hull fails, at the cost of some top speed

shield_capacitor.name: Shield Capacitor
shield_capacitor.description: A charged buffer field around the hull - raises the damage the ship can take before it fails. No speed penalty; fits a utility mount

sensor_array.name: Sensor Array
sensor_array.description: Long-baseline scanner - reads a targeted ship's faction, standing, and hull state on the HUD so you know what you're closing on
